description: This is a Java class named InventoryWorker that provides utility methods for handling inventory-related queries related to purchase and sales orders in the OFBiz framework. It includes methods to fetch outstanding purchase orders, calculate outstanding quantities, and retrieve quantities of products in various order types.

classes.name: InventoryWorker
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to query and compute inventory and order statuses such as outstanding purchase orders, quantities, and related metrics.

methods.name: getOutstandingPurchaseOrders
methods.description: Retrieves all outstanding purchase orders for a specific product, excluding orders in completed, canceled, or rejected statuses.

methods.name: getOutstandingPurchasedQuantity
methods.description: Calculates the net outstanding ordered quantity for a product by summing quantities from outstanding purchase orders after accounting for cancellations.

methods.name: getOutstandingProductQuantities
methods.description: Returns a map of product IDs to their outstanding quantities across all orders of a given type (sales or purchase), using a view entity.

methods.name: getOutstandingProductQuantitiesForSalesOrders
methods.description: Wrapper method to get outstanding product quantities specifically for sales orders.

methods.name: getOutstandingProductQuantitiesForPurchaseOrders
methods.description: Wrapper method to get outstanding product quantities specifically for purchase orders.
